title: Don’t waste your time
text: Don’t waste your time. I had these pillow cases for about 6 months and they look like I’ve had them for forever. It started getting pills after a month and just got worst. I ended up buying different cases. I had the teal blue color and it didn’t stand up for very long to minimal usage. Save your time and money...wish I did!
